description: Non-standard field separator (#) and encoding characters (@%!$) read from this message's own MSH-1/MSH-2, fixing SPEC.md §7's 'MSH-1/MSH-2 must be standard' limitation (spec 005 User Story 2, SC-002).

MSH-1 ($) also reappears as MSH-2's subcomponent character, proving MSH-1/MSH-2 are read positionally (fixed byte offsets 3 and 4-7) rather than by searching for a character, so the coincidental repeat causes no ambiguity (spec 005 User Story 2 Acceptance Scenario 3).
